title: Bike Engine Components Manufacturer in Kenya | Autologic
description: Autologic Industries exports bike engine components for Kenya, precision-made to OEM tolerances for motorcycles on rough roads and long days.
banner_desc: Accurately made engine parts for motorcycles working hard on Kenyan roads.
hero_sub: Dust, Vibration and Long Days: Accuracy Matters
hero: A motorcycle on Kenyan murram roads lives with fine red dust in the dry season, mud in the rains and constant vibration from potholes. Parts made to loose tolerances wear quickly under that treatment. Our bike engine components for Kenya are made to OEM tolerances so engines keep running well between overhauls.
Components come from our CNC machining and die casting lines at an IATF 16949 certified plant, and they fit without filing or shimming.
We follow international standards for design and materials and test parts for demanding conditions.
When fitting new engine parts, mechanics should always check the air filter. A torn or clogged filter lets abrasive dust into the engine and undoes the benefit of new components.
Engine parts can share a container with clutch parts for economical shipping to Mombasa.

faq_intro: Questions from Kenyan distributors and mechanics about our engine parts.
faqs: Why do tolerances matter on rough roads?
Dust and vibration speed up wear, and poorly fitting parts wear unevenly and fail sooner.
Send model names, part numbers or a sample.
What should be checked when fitting new parts?
The air filter and oil, so dust and dirt do not damage the new components.
Can you make parts from drawings?
Yes, after a feasibility review, with samples for approval.
Can engine and clutch parts ship together?
Yes, in one container to Mombasa.
